answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus on AMR-to-text generation where the goal is to generate a fluent and grammatical sentence that is faithful to a given AMR graph ... We evaluate on LDC2017T10 and LDC2020T02 corpora.
answer_1.outputs: Generated natural language sentences describing the input AMR graphs

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the results with BLEU and chrF++ metrics. We also report the meaning (M) component of the MF-score ... We use BERTScore allowing a semantic evaluation that depends less on the surface forms.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation via crowdsourcing using Amazon Mechanical Turk. ... annotators then rate on a 1-7 Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate the meaning similarity between the generated text and the reference sentence on a 1-7 Likert scale.
